newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Zaire threatens war on Rwanda, Burundi.
newsitem.headline: Zaire threatens war on Rwanda, Burundi.

text.p: Zaire said on Friday it would wage war on Burundi and Rwanda to defend its territory which it said had been violated by the two neighbouring states in fighting in its east.

"We are determined to wage a total war... We have the means," Zairean deputy Foreign Minister Lokondo Yoka, who is on an explanatory mission around Europe and northern Africa, told a news conference in Brussels.

"(The towns of) Uvira, Goma and Bukavu have been occupied by Burundian and Rwandan forces for almost two weeks," he said, adding the world's media had been disinformed about who were the real aggressors in the conflict.
"The Banyamulenge, a so-called ethnic group, are just refugees from Rwanda," he said, referring to the Kigali-backed rebel group which played a key role in capturing the towns.

He warned any international intervention force sent to create safe corridors between the fighting parties for the passage of humanitarian aid for hundreds of thousands of refugees in the area, would only be tolerated on Zairean soil as long as it did not offer protection to Rwandans or Burundians.
"The force nust be neutral...it must not hinder Zaire from protecting its territory," the minister said.
